name: The Woman Caught in Adultery
title: Recipient of Jesus' Grace
summary: An unnamed woman who was brought to Jesus by the scribes and Pharisees after being caught in adultery. She was used as a trap to test Jesus, but instead became a witness to his wisdom and grace when he challenged her accusers and refused to condemn her.

keyEvents.title: Brought to Jesus by Her Accusers
keyEvents.description: The scribes and Pharisees brought the woman to Jesus in the temple after she had been caught in adultery, presenting her publicly before the crowd.

keyEvents.title: The Trap Set for Jesus
keyEvents.description: The accusers referred to the Law of Moses, which required stoning, and asked Jesus what he thought in order to test him.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Writes on the Ground
keyEvents.description: Jesus bent down and wrote with his finger on the ground instead of answering the accusers' question immediately.

keyEvents.title: He Who Is Without Sin
keyEvents.description: Jesus stood up and spoke these famous words: 'Let anyone among you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her.' All the accusers left one by one.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Refuses to Condemn
keyEvents.description: When all the accusers had gone, Jesus told the woman that he did not condemn her either, and instructed her to go and sin no more.
